WITH ex AS (
  SELECT e.*, m.member_id, m.marketing_consent, m.valid_from, m.valid_to
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM ex),
h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ex) AS rows_,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT exposure_id) FROM ex) AS distinct_exp_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ids) AS members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ids JOIN h USING(member_id)) AS in_both,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ex WHERE NOT delivered) AS undelivered_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM ex WHERE delivered) AS delivered_members,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM ex WHERE NOT marketing_consent) AS noconsent_members,
 (SELECT min(contact_ts_utc) FROM ex) AS mn, (SELECT max(contact_ts_utc) FROM ex) AS mx,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ex WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', contact_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) NOT BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24') AS outside_window,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=19 AND member_key NOT IN (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member)) AS orphan_keys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT exposure_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_exp_ids_all

WITH contacted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.quantity, s.store_id, m.member_id,
         COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, (w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_web
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT count(DISTINCT l.member_id) AS buying_members, count(DISTINCT l.sales_line_id) AS n_lines, count(*) AS rows_,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS net_before_returns,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_web THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS web_part,
       SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 AND NOT is_web THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS web_no_dispatch
FROM lines l JOIN contacted c USING(member_id)
WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'

SELECT 'dup_line_id' AS chk, count(*) AS n, 0 AS x FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-20' AND DATE '2026-06-10' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', count(*), 0 FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-20' AND DATE '2026-06-10' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'etl_loaded_day_' || CAST(CAST(etl_loaded_at AS DATE) AS VARCHAR), count(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' GROUP BY CAST(etl_loaded_at AS DATE)
UNION ALL SELECT 'member_versions_overlap', count(*), 0 FROM dim_member a JOIN dim_member b ON a.member_id=b.member_id AND a.member_key<b.member_key AND a.valid_from<=b.valid_to AND b.valid_from<=a.valid_to
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_orders_processing_in_window', count(*), 0 FROM fact_web_order WHERE status='processing'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_null_member_loggedin', count(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_member_mismatch', count(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE f.member_key IS DISTINCT FROM o.member_key

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS mth, o.login_state,
  count(*) AS lines, sum(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS line_member_null,
  sum(CASE WHEN o.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_member_null,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND o.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.member_key<>o.member_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keys_differ
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH elig AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE marketing_consent AND DATE '2026-05-04' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to AND join_date <= DATE '2026-05-04'),
con AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM elig) AS eligible,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM elig WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM con) AND member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM h)) AS elig_neither,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM con WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM elig)) AS contacted_not_elig,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM elig)) AS holdout_not_elig,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h) AS holdout_members

WITH contacted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id = 19),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
spend AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24')
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM contacted) AS members_contacted,
       (SELECT SUM(sp.net_amount) FROM spend sp JOIN contacted c USING (member_id)) AS net_sales_before_returns_eur
